description.value: Pizzarama Pizza is a pizza takeout and delivery shop in the Nechako Centre mall in Kitimat, BC, currently transitioning its brand to Canadian2for1Pizza. For cyclists on the north coast route, Kitimat sits at the head of the Douglas Channel and this shop offers a convenient hot meal stop in the town centre. Online ordering is available alongside in-person service.

address.value: 171 Nechako Centre, Kitimat, British Columbia V8C 1M8, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://pizzarama.ca confirms the business is operational and located at 171 Nechako Centre, Kitimat, BC V8C 1M8, with phone 250-639-9241. The site explicitly mentions online ordering and door delivery ('PAY WITH DEBIT, VISA, OR MASTERCARD RIGHT AT YOUR DOOR!'), confirming takeout/delivery service. The business is actively rebranding to Canadian2for1Pizza; no evidence on the site addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling amenities.
concerns: Business is actively rebranding from 'Pizzarama Pizza' to 'Canadian2for1Pizza'; the OSM name and website URL may become outdated soon.
OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website only and cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fast food pizza business in Kitimat with an active website and current contact information; useful to touring cyclists as a meal stop.
